event.ione_heart2.0.text: Oh, [player]! Come and see. This was folded in the back of an old almanac.
event.ione_heart2.0.why: ties the find to her almanacs

event.ione_heart2.1.text: A chart of the coast. The ink is nearly gone, but look. Someone drew every cove by hand.
event.ione_heart2.1.why: specific detail; her love of the sea shown, not said

event.ione_heart2.2.text: Take them. I thought you'd know what to do with a shell. I only know how to file one.
event.ione_heart2.2.why: explains the seashell gift; librarian understatement last

event.ione_heart5.0.text: There's something I wanted to ask you. I wrote it on a slip so I'd get it right.

event.ione_heart5.1.text: Would you walk the beach with me one evening? Only if you'd like. I'm told the tide doesn't mind either way.
event.ione_heart5.1.why: the ask, softened with a joke at the tide

event.ione_heart5.2.text: Oh. Good. Then take this. I found it on the shore one winter, years ago. It's waited in a drawer long enough.
event.ione_heart5.2.why: explains the pearl; hints she loves the winter sea

event.reading_night.0.text: Four chairs, one lamp, and a pot of tea nobody asked for. This is my calm face. Does it work?
event.reading_night.0.why: keeps Hazel's cue; nerves under the hostessing

event.reading_night.poem_after.text: I'll copy that out by hand, Hazel. Not for a shelf. For the desk drawer, where the good things go.
event.reading_night.poem_after.why: praise as a private act; keeps Hazel's secret safe

event.reading_night.4.text: A snowdrop, for the lamp. ...Every chair taken. Next time I'll set out a fifth and leave the door open.
event.reading_night.4.why: her favorite flower lands; her want for more readers points forward

event.festival_winter_lanterns.3.text: That's the bell. Together now, and slowly. Let them go. ...Mine is drifting toward the sea. I didn't steer it.
event.festival_winter_lanterns.3.why: keeps her wish private while giving it away

event.ione_heart8.intro.text: Come with me, if you have a minute. There's a shelf at the back I've never shown anyone. It's a little sad. It's mine.
event.ione_heart8.intro.why: tighter; the confession lands on the last word

dlg.ione.shelf.0.text: At the back of the library stands a tall shelf. Every book has a slip of paper tucked inside. Not one slip has a name.

dlg.ione.shelf.1.text: Books I set aside for people who never came in. The oldest has waited nine years. I can't reshelve them. What would you do?
dlg.ione.shelf.1.why: a number makes the sadness specific

dlg.ione.shelf.c0.text: Take one to someone who should have it.

dlg.ione.shelf.c2.text: Tuck a note in one, for whoever comes.

dlg.ione.shelf.r0.text: Take one. ...To someone who'll actually read it. Yes. That's all any of them wanted.
dlg.ione.shelf.r0.why: she speaks for the books, meaning herself

dlg.ione.shelf.r1.text: Aloud? Nobody has ever read these to anyone. Go slowly, please. They'll want to keep up.
dlg.ione.shelf.r1.why: warm, then a gentle joke about the books

dlg.ione.shelf.r2.text: A note, in a book nobody's opened. Now whoever comes will know someone was expecting them.
dlg.ione.shelf.r2.why: names why the note matters to her

event.ione_heart8.after.text: {if choice:shelf.take}The first set-aside book ever to leave the shelf. I've written it in the ledger. Tell me who it went to. Not yet. Once they've read it.{else}{if choice:shelf.read}You read one aloud. The shelf has never been so quiet. I think that was it listening.{else}I won't move your note. I won't even read it. ...Not this week, anyway.{/if}{/if}
event.ione_heart8.after.why: each branch keeps its payoff; take branch leaves a promise

event.ione_birthday.intro.text: It's my birthday. The fuss is a new book I don't open until noon. Come in. I set something aside for you, too.
event.ione_birthday.intro.why: fresh take on the shipped birthday line; seashell gift set up

dlg.ione.birthday.0.text: The new book can wait. It's very patient. What shall we do?

dlg.ione.birthday.c0.text: Wish her the happiest of birthdays.

dlg.ione.birthday.c1.text: Read the first page to her.

dlg.ione.birthday.c2.text: Give her a bookmark. A slightly crooked one.

dlg.ione.birthday.r0.text: Thank you. I'll keep that between two good pages, where I'll come across it often.
dlg.ione.birthday.r0.why: her way of keeping a kindness

dlg.ione.birthday.r1.text: The first page, aloud. Nobody's read to me since I was small. Slowly, please.

dlg.ione.birthday.r2.text: A bookmark. From you. It's crooked. So is my favorite book. They'll get along.

event.ione_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.ione.wish}It's tucked between two good pages now. I'll come across it all winter.{else}{if choice:bday.ione.read}A birthday with someone reading to me. The books heard. They're being very discreet.{else}The bookmark's holding a very good place. I'd been using a tea label.{/if}{/if}
event.ione_birthday.after.why: each branch lands on a small, specific word

event.ione_courtship.intro.text: I've read hundreds of love stories, and not one told me how to ask this. So, plainly: would you court me? I rewrote that eleven times.

dlg.ione.courtship.0.text: What do you say? Take your time. I'll pretend to shelve something.

dlg.ione.courtship.c0.text: Yes. I'd like that very much.

dlg.ione.courtship.c1.text: I'd rather we stayed good friends.

dlg.ione.courtship.c2.text: Could we wait a while? Bookmark it?

dlg.ione.courtship.r0.text: Yes. ...Oh, good. Good. I'll clear a shelf for the two of us. A small one, by the window.

dlg.ione.courtship.r1.text: Friends. That's a lovely thing to be, and the best stories start there. You were kind to say it plainly.

dlg.ione.courtship.r2.text: Wait. Of course. A good book isn't rushed. I'll keep the question by the desk bell.
dlg.ione.courtship.r2.why: her signature sound as the bookmark

event.ione_courtship.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.ione.yes}A courtship, then. I'll begin properly: the first page of a new book, read aloud. Sunday. Bring nothing.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.ione.friends}Friends, then. A good shelf to share. I'll lend you everything and ask for nothing back on time.{else}Take all the time you need. The library is very good at keeping a place.{/if}{/if}
event.ione_courtship.after.why: yes branch gets a day; friends branch stays warm

event.ione_courtship2.intro.text: You asked me to wait, so I did. I reread the question instead, many times. It held up. Would you court me?
event.ione_courtship2.intro.why: the second ask no longer repeats the first word for word

event.ione_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.ione.yes}A courtship, then. I'll begin properly: the first page of a new book, read aloud. Sunday. Bring nothing.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.ione.friends}Friends, then. A good shelf to share. I'll lend you everything and ask for nothing back on time.{else}Still not yet. That's all right. Waiting is most of a librarian's job.{/if}{/if}
event.ione_courtship2.after.why: later branch acknowledges this is the second wait

event.ione_partners.intro.text: Come in, and sit. I wrote you a letter. It runs four pages. I'll read it, and you'll pretend not to blush.

dlg.ione.partners.0.text: I've set the rest of the day aside for you. How shall we spend it?
dlg.ione.partners.0.why: scene plays in daytime, so not 'evening'

dlg.ione.partners.c1.text: Read to her among the stacks.

dlg.ione.partners.c2.text: Walk the shore. The letter can come too.

dlg.ione.partners.r0.text: Every word. Thank you. ...I'm the one blushing, and I wrote it.
dlg.ione.partners.r0.why: tighter turn on her own joke

dlg.ione.partners.r1.text: You read, and the books lean in. They've missed being listened to. ...So had I.

dlg.ione.partners.r2.text: The shore, with you. I'll bring a book and not open it. From a librarian, that's devotion.

event.ione_partners.after.text: {if choice:courtship.ione.letter}The letter's in my favorite book now, marking the best page. Both are yours, eventually.{else}{if choice:courtship.ione.read}Your voice, my library. The books haven't said a word since. I think they approve.{else}The shore was bright. I forgot the book entirely. ...I'd like to see it in winter. With you.{/if}{/if}
event.ione_partners.after.why: shore branch finally says the sea-in-winter wish aloud

event.overheard_hazel_ione_1.l2.text: You found it. I'd looked for a week. The library's quiet is really yours. I only dust it.
event.overheard_hazel_ione_1.l2.why: credit given to Hazel, self-deprecation last

event.overheard_hazel_ione_1.l4.text: Agreed. Back to the tea, then. I'll even stir quietly.

event.overheard_hazel_ione_2.l1.text: There's a book on the desk seven years overdue. The card has your name on it, Hazel.
event.overheard_hazel_ione_2.l1.why: exact, not scolding; the reveal lands last

event.overheard_hazel_ione_2.l3.text: You've been on the last chapter for seven years?
event.overheard_hazel_ione_2.l3.why: plain setup so Hazel's reply gets the laugh

event.overheard_hazel_ione_3.l1.text: I put a chair by the window. It has a cushion. It's for whoever needs it.
event.overheard_hazel_ione_3.l1.why: the gift disguised as a general offer

event.overheard_hazel_ione_3.l3.text: You didn't say a word. I heard it anyway. The window's warm after lunch.
event.overheard_hazel_ione_3.l3.why: answers Hazel's unspoken thanks; a time to come

event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l2.text: Dr. Penn. The clinic stayed open two. I could see your lamp.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l2.why: exact counter, with a concrete witness

event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l4.text: Then we'll both go home on time. Starting tomorrow.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l4.why: the promise undercut by its own date

event.overheard_odalys_ione_2.l2.text: And I prescribe you a novel, Dr. Penn. One chapter. Equally non-negotiable.

event.overheard_odalys_ione_2.l4.text: Done. I picked a book whose first chapter is two pages. Sleep well.

event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l2.text: It's the calm kind. Hazel had three cups and reorganized nothing all afternoon.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l2.why: evidence as a joke, not a medical claim

event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l4.text: Always. Here. It's gone a little cold. That's the slow part working.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l4.why: warm close that plays along with 'remedy'

adds.text: And these were tucked in the fold. Two shells. Somebody meant to come back for them.
adds.why: sets up the seashell gift as part of the find

adds.text: There's a cove at the very edge, where the ink gives out. I imagine it's lovely in winter.
adds.why: closing thread: the sea in winter, said sideways

adds.text: I've lost the slip. It's somewhere in Poetry. ...Never mind. I remember it.
adds.why: a real nervous beat before the ask

adds.text: Evenings, then. The almanac marks the low tides. I've circled three already. In ink.
adds.why: ends on a promise with her almanacs attached
